name: temurfitpro
description: TemurFitPro — multi-tenant SaaS ratsion nazorat platformasi (Telegram)

scripts.dev: node scripts/prestart.js && npx tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run generate && cd client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.generate: npx prisma generate --schema prisma/platform.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema prisma/tenant.prisma
scripts.sql:tenant: npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/tenant.prisma --script > prisma/tenant-init.sql
scripts.test:delivery: CONTROL_BOT_TOKEN=1:test ENCRYPTION_KEY=dGVzdC1rZXktZm9yLXVuaXQtdGVzdHMtMDEyMzQ1Ng== SUPER_ADMIN_IDS=1 PUBLIC_URL=https://example.test AI_ENABLED=false DATA_DIR=$(mktemp -d) sh -c 'node scripts/prestart.js && npx tsx scripts/test-delivery.ts'
